content_sections.heading: ESIC Hospital Rudrapur Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
ESIC Hospital Rudrapur Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Hospital Rudrapur?
faq.answer: ESIC Hospital Rudrapur has announced a total of 46 vacancies for the posts of Specialist / Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on different dates from 08 September 2026 to 11 September 2026, depending on the specialty.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Specialist posts?
faq.answer: For Specialist posts, candidates need to have an MBBS degree along with a PG Degree/Diploma (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant specialty and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Specialist / Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 69 years. However, age relaxation for Senior Resident posts is applicable as per Government of India rules, up to a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,000/- per month for Part-Time Specialists to Rs. 67,700/- plus allowances for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the General/OBC category?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the General/OBC category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview is between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Where is ESIC Hospital Rudrapur located?
faq.answer: ESIC Hospital Rudrapur is located in Rudrapur, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 263153.
